terms.comment: Quintilian’s word: nōmina neutrālia. Adverb neutrāliter, in the neuter (Traupman 247).

terms.gloss: neuter; of verbs, neither active nor passive
terms.comment: The grammarians’ phrase is neutrī generis, of the neuter gender (Charisius, Diomedes), and Traupman’s genus neutrum (221). Verba neutra are verbs neither active nor passive, that is intransitive (see intransitive).

sources: Lewis & Short: neutralis · Lewis & Short: neuter
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 221, p. 247.
